answer: A bond of 40% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in delta, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 104 aliases, and each one needs its own funded violet account. Scaling to 509 identities multiplies that fee by 896 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
